ORDER 1 of 1, PAPER account, Alpaca
  BUY 8 TSLA, market, good for today
  stop-loss 358.32
  take-profit 370.04
  max loss about $46.88 if the stop fills at 358.32 (it can fill worse in a fast market)
  why: opening-range breakout on TSLA: 8 shares, bound by your $50 max loss per trade (8 x 5.86 = $46.88 at the stop)
  READY: trader-risk PASS, waiting for your yes
  Claude will call place_stock_order with exactly:
    {
      "symbol": "TSLA",
      "side": "buy",
      "qty": "8",
      "type": "market",
      "time_in_force": "day",
      "order_class": "bracket",
      "take_profit_limit_price": "370.04",
      "stop_loss_stop_price": "358.32"
    }
  Alpaca places the entry, then the stop-loss and the take-profit as two orders
  that cancel each other: when one fills, the other is canceled.
  Reply "yes" to place this one order, or "no" to skip it.
  Claude's own card then asks again: Allow once places it, Deny stops it.

One order at a time: a yes covers one ticket, never the batch. Education and tooling, not financial advice.
